evidence: Labeled 'Validation' and touches core validation functions in src/validation.cpp, src/node/blockstorage.cpp, and src/consensus/validation.h.
rationale: Decouples fatal runtime failures from consensus validation state across validation and block storage functions. Retires an error-handling hazard where non-validating routines were forced to take a `BlockValidationState` out-parameter to signal disk or memory errors, and unblocks clean value returns in validation methods (#35570).
